articles.title: Ketan Purohit launches campaign for TDSB Ward 12 Trustee
articles.excerpt: Surrounded by parents, students, and volunteers, Ketan officially kicked off his campaign with a promise: to be a full-time, listen-first voice for Ward 12 families.

articles.title: Recap: our first community town hall
articles.excerpt: Over 150 neighbours joined us to talk safer schools, mental-health supports, and how the board can be more open with families.

articles.title: Local educators and parent groups back Ketan
articles.excerpt: A growing coalition of teachers, parent councils, and community organizations are lending their support to the campaign.

articles.title: Our plan for mental health in every school
articles.excerpt: Ketan released a detailed plan to expand counselling access and speed up support for students who need it most.
